payload.rationale: PathMNIST's 9-class histopathology task with 107k samples and mild 1.63x imbalance supports a compact 16-unit hidden layer and 128 batch size for stable, low-cost training. Standardize normalization and geometric augmentations (hflip/vflip/rotate90) reduce the need for heavy capacity. Class weighting is enabled to offset the mild imbalance. LR 1e-3 with weight decay 0.01 keeps optimization stable within the 8-epoch budget, avoiding overfitting on the small architecture.
